# Where Yīnyáng works now: the myths behind the markets
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Yīnyáng**'s was unusually clear.

Yīnyáng has no origin myth in the usual sense. It is a lens through which Chinese thinkers read the origin of everything. Its stories are therefore cosmological and medical rather than biographical.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Yīnyáng
- **Pantheon:** Taoist
- **Domain of influence:** Cosmic Duality
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Health & Wellbeing · Home & Lifestyle · Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 270 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**One Yin, One Yang.** The Xici appendices of the Yijing state: 'One yin and one yang, this is called the Dao. ' The cosmos is not governed by a personal deity but by the alternation of these two modes. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**All Things Carry Yin and Embrace Yang.** Daodejing 42 says that the ten thousand things 'carry yin on their backs and embrace yang in their arms,' achieving harmony through the blending of chongqi — the empty or vital breath.  Yin and yang are not external forces but the internal structure of every existing thing. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine

*Medicine, pharmaceuticals, and public health. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Diagnosis in traditional Chinese medicine begins by sorting yin from yang; the clinic's organizing axis.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Yoga, Meditation & Holistic Wellness

*Yoga, meditation, and mind-body practice. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*The balance of opposites; wellness branding’s favorite diagram.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Architecture & Spatial Design

*Architecture, interior design, and spatial harmony. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*Yang light and yin shade orient the building; the feng shui compass at the drafting table.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Philosophy, Ethics & Standards

*Philosophy, ethics boards, and standards bodies. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Complementarity as a way of thinking.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Sports, Fitness & Competition

*Athletics, fitness brands, and competitive leagues. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Yin absorbs, yang strikes; the martial artist's first grammar.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Yīnyáng performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Yīnyáng has no origin myth in the usual sense. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in healthcare, pharma & medicine, yoga, meditation & holistic wellness, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/yinyang/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
